```yaml
name: SDK CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    tags: [ 'v*' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to use (defaults to pyproject.toml)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  version-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Get version from pyproject.toml
        id: get_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep -E "^version\s*=" pyproject.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Validate tag matches version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG_VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}
          if [[ "$TAG_VERSION" != "${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Tag version ($TAG_VERSION) does not match pyproject.toml version (${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }})"
            exit 1
          fi

  sdk-generation:
    needs: version-validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install pyyaml
      - name: Generate SDK
        run: |
          uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate
      - name: Validate SDK generation
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "sdk" ]; then
            echo "SDK directory was not created"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ ! -f "sdk/package.json" ]; then
            echo "package.json was not created"
            exit 1
          fi

  python-publish:
    needs: [version-validation, sdk-generation]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Build package
        run: |
          uv pip install build
          python -m build
      - name: Publish to PyPI
        env:
          PYPI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          uv pip install twine
          twine upload dist/*

  sdk-publish:
    needs: [version-validation, sdk-generation]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          pnpm --version
      - name: Setup pnpm
        run: |
          pnpm install
      - name: Publish to npm
        run: |
          pnpm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

  sdk-ci:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install pyyaml
      - name: Generate SDK
        run: |
          uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate
      - name: Validate SDK generation
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "sdk" ]; then
            echo "SDK directory was not created"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ ! -f "sdk/package.json" ]; then
            echo "package.json was not created"
            exit 1
          fi
```
